title: Does algebraic structure make lattice cryptography easier to break?
question: When, and by how much, does ring or module structure reduce the cost of recovering a secret from noisy linear equations?
summary: Compare ordinary LWE with ring and module variants under matched parameters. Measure the effect of structure, explain any advantage, and test whether it survives realistic secret distributions and larger dimensions. Begin with a reproducible small-instance baseline; record failed attacks and independent checks.
